note: Curated collections of Agent Skills. Checked 2026-11-20: every repository exists on GitHub; `stars` is from the GitHub API and `installs` is the sum over that repository's skills shown on the skills.sh home page that day. Left out on purpose: repositories with almost no stars and millions of installs (several are copies of obra/superpowers under other names) — install counts can be inflated. Trust is by origin, never by popularity.
